lede: Vail celebrates Christmas with a German style market at Christ Lutheran Vail and the Nutcracker at the Vail Theatre of the Arts, a Southeast Tucson tradition.
celebrates: Christ Lutheran Vail turns its courtyard into a ChristKindl Markt, a German style Christmas market with handcrafted vendors, German food, live music and a silent auction. Its Journey to Bethlehem lets visitors trace Mary and Joseph's steps with a tour guide and ends at a hot cocoa station, while the Kinderdorf, the children's village, offers hands on crafts and a snow pit, and Santa and Mrs. Claus visit. A few weeks later, Ballet Rincon stages The Nutcracker at the Vail Theatre of the Arts with guest artists, Ensemble Program dancers and Academy students.
lastyear: In 2025, Ballet Rincon staged The Nutcracker at the Vail Theatre of the Arts on December 19 and 20, according to an Instagram post from the company that pointed families to its ticket information page. The company's Facebook page calls the production a beloved Southeast Tucson tradition for over two decades. The same theatre hosted Empire High School's production of Into the Woods in March 2026, according to the school's ticket page.
facts: Kinderdorf is German for children's village, and Christ Lutheran Vail uses the name for the kids' area of its ChristKindl Markt. The church's guided Journey to Bethlehem tours begin at 3 pm and the last tour leaves at 6:30 pm, and visitors can also walk the route on their own. Ballet Rincon's website lists the Nutcracker as a winter holiday tradition at the Vail Theatre of the Arts, at 10701 E. Mary Ann Cleveland Way.
trains: Vail has no train service of its own. The nearest Amtrak stations are Tucson and Benson, both served by the Sunset Limited and the Texas Eagle, according to Amtrak. In Tucson, the Southern Arizona Transportation Museum sits in the old Southern Pacific depot and shows steam locomotive 1673, and Old Pueblo Trolley in South Tucson keeps historic streetcars. The Verde Canyon Railroad's Magical Christmas Journey runs in Clarkdale, far to the north.

faq: A ChristKindl Markt is a German style Christmas market. At Christ Lutheran Vail it has handcrafted vendors, German food, live music, a silent auction, visits with Santa and Mrs. Claus, a Journey to Bethlehem tour and a Kinderdorf for children.
Where is the Vail Theatre of the Arts?
The theatre is at 10701 E. Mary Ann Cleveland Way, southeast of Tucson. It hosts Ballet Rincon's The Nutcracker and school productions, and the ballet's tickets are sold online through Etix.
Can kids meet Santa in Vail?

Santa and Mrs. Claus visit the ChristKindl Markt at Christ Lutheran Vail. The Santa visit is listed for the afternoon, and the church's page gives the exact hours. See the event listing on this page for the time.
Is there a train ride near Vail?

There is no Christmas train ride in Vail. The nearest historic train displays are the Southern Arizona Transportation Museum and Old Pueblo Trolley in Tucson, and the closest Christmas train on our Arizona list is the Verde Canyon Railroad in Clarkdale.
